measuredSpectrum.source: HST Low Resolution Stellar Library (LowLib, HLSP lead Guy Worthey; https://doi.org/10.17909/kmdt-pw63), GJ 551: HST/STIS G230LB, G430L and G750L spectra from programme 13776, 171-1008 nm
measuredSpectrum.note: Space spectrophotometry taken 2015-04-26, the flux corrected for scattered light and an off-centre slit. Proxima flares, so the colour is one moment. It replaces the X-Shooter Spectral Library spectrum (MD021), whose colour (#ffc073) disagreed with both this spectrum and Gaia DR3 XP.
